subject: Weekly MAP Sync — Integration Gateways, Auth Rollout & Eval Sprint
messages:
From: Maria Gonzalez <maria.gonzalez@elliptichealth.com>
To: hannah.schmitt@redwood.inference.com, camila.reyes@redwood.inference.com, karthik.iyer@redwood.inference.com
Cc: sam.liu@elliptichealth.com
Date: Thu, 15 Mar 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP checkpoint: proposed agenda + attachments

Hi team,

Thanks for the continued momentum — attaching the latest MAP (MAP-v0.3.xlsx) with the customer-side evaluation checklist and acceptance criteria. High-level asks for this week's checkpoint:

- Confirm SDK integration owners and ETA for auth shim (we need an SDK release candidate to run streaming + tool-call smoke tests).
- Lock the evaluation plan cut (test vectors + success thresholds) so Elastic Health can schedule QA cycles next week.
- Confirm any gating items that will affect our close runway (legal/infra/procurement).

Quick notes from our side: QA wants streaming end-to-end tests by 3/22; procurement flagged a potential SOC 2 evidence gap (we'll follow up separately). I've added a short comment column in the sheet for your owners.

Proposed 30m checkpoint: Fri 3/16 10:00am PT (Zoom link below) — please confirm or suggest alternatives.

Attachments: MAP-v0.3.xlsx (spreadsheet)
Related: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cMAP

Thanks,
Maria
Product Ops | Elliptic Health

[Attachment: MAP-v0.3.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)]

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.inference.com>
To: Maria Gonzalez <maria.gonzalez@elliptichealth.com>, camila.reyes@redwood.inference.com, karthik.iyer@redwood.inference.com
Cc: priyom.das@redwood.inference.com, neha.kapoor@redwood.inference.com
Date: Thu, 15 Mar 2028 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP checkpoint: proposed agenda + attachments

Thanks Maria — received and reviewed the sheet. Appreciate the clear acceptance criteria. Quick response while I sync the team:

- Friday 3/16 10:00am PT works for us; we'll use the Zoom link you provided.
- I'll own the procurement/SLA conversation and will loop Legal if the SOC 2 ask needs a formal evidence package.
- Camila, can you confirm the SDK RC target date today? If we miss 3/22 for streaming E2E, we should set a contingency (canary model variant) for the evaluation run.

Agenda suggestion for the 30m: 1) SDK build + auth status (10m) 2) Streaming/tool-calls smoke test plan (10m) 3) Close runway risks and next steps (10m).

Hannah
Director, GTM Partnerships | Redwood Inference

--
Hannah Schmitt
Redwood Inference

From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.inference.com>
To: hannah.schmitt@redwood.inference.com, Maria Gonzalez <maria.gonzalez@elliptichealth.com>, karthik.iyer@redwood.inference.com
Cc: priyom.das@redwood.inference.com
Date: Thu, 15 Mar 2028 14:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP checkpoint: proposed agenda + attachments

On Thu, Mar 15, 2028 at 11:05 AM Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.inference.com> wrote:
> Thanks Maria — received and reviewed the sheet. Appreciate the clear acceptance criteria.

Thanks — adding a technical breakdown and owners so the Friday call is actionable.

SDK / API integration (owner: camila_reyes)
- Action: Finalize auth shim for SDK (OAuth + optional API-key fallback).
  - Deliverable: auth-flow diagram + code snippet for SDK (see attached auth-flow.drawio.png).
  - ETA: 2028-03-20 for RC (branch: elliptic/rc-20280320).
- Action: Add streaming example and test harness to SDK repo.
  - Deliverable: streaming-smoke.js + integration test (will run in CI against staging).
  - ETA: 2028-03-22 (blocking for customer QA).

Auth & security (owner: karthik_iyer, support: neha_kapoor)
- Action: Confirm token rotation window for long-lived streaming sessions (recommend 24h refresh with KV cache migration).
  - Blocker: key management team needs to confirm HSM integration by 3/18.
- Action: Provide SOC 2 doc pointers and temporary evidence exports for procurement.
  - ETA: 3/17 (Neha will curate).

Streaming / tool-calling (owner: priyom_das)
- Action: Smoke test plan for streaming + tool call sequences (3 variants: normal throughput, burst, auth-token refresh).
  - Deliverable: streaming-smoke-runbook.md + observed latency matrix.
  - ETA: initial run 3/22; full pass 3/24.

Close runway & eval plan (owner: hannah_schmitt)
- Action: Decide on acceptance window and final eval dataset cut by 3/19 so customer QA can schedule runs.

Attachments referenced: auth-flow.drawio.png (diagram)

Notes: If the SDK RC slips beyond 3/20 we should schedule a shortened E2E with a Redwood-hosted shim to unblock Elliptic QA.

Camila Reyes
Sr. Product Manager, Integrations | Redwood Inference

[Attachment: auth-flow.drawio.png (image/png)]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference.com>
To: camila.reyes@redwood.inference.com, hannah.schmitt@redwood.inference.com, Maria Gonzalez <maria.gonzalez@elliptichealth.com>
Cc: priyom.das@redwood.inference.com, neha.kapoor@redwood.inference.com
Date: Fri, 16 Mar 2028 16:25:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP checkpoint: proposed agenda + attachments

On Thu, Mar 15, 2028 at 2:40 PM Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.inference.com> wrote:
> Thanks — adding a technical breakdown and owners so the Friday call is actionable.

Short follow-up after today's discussion (thanks all for the fast sync):

- HSM / key management: confirmed initial integration window with infra on 3/18. If that slips we will ship a temporary token-provider container for staging to allow the streaming tests to proceed.
- SDK RC: I reviewed the branch and signoffs look good; camila, please tag rc-20280320 by EOD Monday so QA can pull it.
- Canary option: Recommend we provision a small dedicated pool (2x A100-equivalent) to run the evaluation workload if production routing or capacity becomes a gating risk — ops@vecor.io can stand this up in 48h if we approve.

Action items agreed:
- Camila: tag SDK RC (rc-20280320) — ETA 2028-03-20 ("camila_reyes").
- Neha: collect SOC2 pointer docs and evidence snapshot — ETA 2028-03-17 ("neha_kapoor").
- Priyom: publish streaming smoke runbook and kick CI jobs — ETA 2028-03-22 ("priyom_das").
- Hannah: approve canary pool if procurement/legal OK — review by 2028-03-18 ("hannah_schmitt").

I'll circulate a short recap and the runbook link after Neha publishes the SOC pointer docs.

Thanks,
Karthik
Engineering Lead, Platform Integrations | Redwood Inference
